library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
# install.packages("shinylive")
library(shinylive)

# shinylive
# https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/

ui <- fluidPage(
    
    # Application title
    titlePanel("Logistic Regression Model: Detection of trauma-related symptom severity"),
    
    # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
            numericInput("gender",
                         "Gender (0 = male, 1 = female):",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 1,
                         value = 0),
            numericInput("age",
                         "Age (Min. = 16, Max. = 61):",
                         min = 16,
                         max = 61,
                         value = 16),
            numericInput("gps17",
                         "GPS item 17 (0 = no, 1 = yes):",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 1,
                         value = 0),
            numericInput("gps19",
                         "GPS item 19 (0 = no, 1 = yes):",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 1,
                         value = 0),
            numericInput("gps20",
                         "GPS item 20 (0 = no, 1 = yes):",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 1,
                         value = 0),
            numericInput("gps21",
                         "GPS item 21 (0 = no, 1 = yes):",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 1,
                         value = 0),
            numericInput("gps22",
                         "GPS item 22 (0 = no, 1 = yes):",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 1,
                         value = 0)
        ),
        
        # tags$h1("See Global Psychotrauma Screen (GPS)")
        
        mainPanel(
            h4("Original content of GPS items 17, 19, 20, 21, and 22?"),
            a(href="https://gps.global-psychotrauma.net/home", "Go to the Global Psychotrauma Screen (GPS) questionnaire."),
            br(),
            h3("The detection probability of trauma-related symptom severity is:"),
            br(),
            # textOutput("pred")
            DT::DTOutput(outputId = "logregTbl"),
            br(),
            h4("Reasonable range of threshold probabilities: 5%-20%."),
            br(),
            h4(paste("If 'detection probability'", expression(">="), "threshold probability, offer treatment.")),
            br(),
            h4("Model formula:"),
            h4("-2.67 + .22 * Gender - .02 * Age + 1.18 * GPS17 + 1.12 * GPS19 + .70 * GPS20 + 1.16 * GPS21 + .52 * GPS22"),
            br(),
            h4("RESEARCH PURPOSE ONLY! This calculator has not been evaluated as part of a clinical trial study and does therefore not count as a medical device."))
    )
)


server <- function(input, output) {
    
    mod <- readRDS("mainModel.rds")
    
    input_df <- reactive({
        data.frame(gender = input$gender,
                   age = input$age,
                   gps17 = input$gps17,
                   gps19 = input$gps19,
                   gps20 = input$gps20,
                   gps21 = input$gps21,
                   gps22 = input$gps22)
    })
    
    pred <- reactive({
        # predict(model, input_df())
        # prlo: predicted log-odds
        prlo <- predict(object = mod, newdata = input_df(), se.fit = TRUE)
        # Lower 95 (l95) and upper 95 (u95) percent CI:
        l95 <- prlo$fit + qnorm(.025) * prlo$se.fit
        u95 <- prlo$fit + qnorm(.975) * prlo$se.fit
        out <- round(c(plogis(prlo$fit), plogis(l95), plogis(u95))*100, digits=2)
        df <- data.frame(c1=out[1],
                         c2=out[2],
                         c3=out[3])
        colnames(df) <- c("Estimated probability (%)", "Lower 95% CI", "Upper 95% CI")
        # https://rstudio.github.io/DT/options.html
        # https://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html
        # https://forum.posit.co/t/centering-columns-and-removing-some-columns-simultaneously-in-dt-shiny-r/23673/2
        # columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = 1:5))
        # https://www.datanovia.com/learn/tools/shiny-apps/interactive-features/data-tables.html
        DT::datatable(df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = 0:2)), dom = 't')) %>% 
            formatStyle(columns = colnames(df), `font-size` = '150%')
        # data.table::setDT(df)
    })
    
    # output$pred <- renderText({pred()})
    output$logregTbl <- DT::renderDT({pred()})
    
    # observeEvent(input$go, {
    #     screenshot()
    # })
    
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
